CustomField.description: Days since last stage change. Zero for Completed or Rejected requests.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Rejected") ), 0, IF( ISBLANK(Last_Stage_Change_Date__c), IF( ISBLANK(Submitted_Date__c), 0, ROUND( (NOW() - Submitted_Date__c) * 24 / 24, 0) ), ROUND( (NOW() - Last_Stage_Change_Date__c) * 24 / 24, 0) ) )
CustomField.label: Days Pending
